award: FIRST Global Winning Alliance Award - Gold
description: Awarded to the four teams in the winning alliance in the final match.
Awarded to the four-team alliance who placed second in the final match.
Awarded to the four-team alliance who placed third.

award: Albert Einstein Award for FIRST Global International Excellence
description: Awarded to teams whose robots performed the best during the FIRST Global Challenge and exemplified all tenets of the FIRST Global community.
Awarded to teams that accrue the most cumulative points over the course of the competition.

award: FIRST Global Innovator Award, in honor of Fred Smith
description: Awarded to the top teams for their New Technology Experience projects, which research and develop solutions to detect, combat, and prevent wildfires.
Recognizes the teams who created outstanding advertisements for their New Technology Experience project.

award: Zhang Heng Award for Engineering Design
description: Awarded to teams whose robot exhibits excellent engineering and displays elegance and effectiveness during the Challenge.

award: Katherine Johnson Award for Engineering Documentation
description: Awarded to teams that demonstrate the journey they took in building their robot.

award: Ustad Ahmad Lahori Award for Innovation in Engineering
description: Awarded to teams that demonstrate creativity and innovation in building their robot to complete an aspect of the Challenge.

award: Jackie Bezos Award for International Enthusiasm
description: Awarded to teams who support each other and other teams throughout the Challenge.

award: Dr. Mae Jemison Award for International Unity
description: Awarded to teams that emulate the best qualities of FIRST Global by breaking down barriers, demonstrating Gracious Professionalism, and building bridges with fellow teams.

award: Rajaâ Cherkaoui El Moursli Award for Courageous Achievement
description: Awarded to teams that exhibit a “can-do” attitude throughout the Challenge, even under difficult circumstances, or when things do not go as planned.
During the course of the competition, the judging panel may decide a team’s unique efforts, performance or dynamics merit recognition.
Awarded to the top-scoring teams in the Skills Challenge, which consists of a solo performance by a robot as it plays the Igniting Innovation robotics game

award: Francisco José de Caldas Award for Sustainable Excellence
description: Awarded to an individual who helped contribute to strong and sustainable FIRST Global programs.
Recognizes teams that impactfully told their story through their team profile video.

award: Margaret and Woodie Flowers Mentorship Award
description: Awarded to mentors who went above and beyond the call of duty for their team.
Awarded to teams that have participated in a majority of the online Social Media Challenges hosted throughout the season.
